verification: Actual inspector HTTP router regression passes with editable closing-title/script name.

Independent renderer probes cover five adversarial names/IDs: title/body/double-quoted name value, attitude, guild goal, mixed-case script close, backslash/quotes, entity-like text and Unicode U+2028/U+2029. JSON literal roundtrips exact persona ID; it contains no raw less-than or line-separator characters.
Static initial chat escapes sender/text; dynamic chat uses textContent, not innerHTML. All five direct-render cases pass in debug and optimized release.
RWF-HTML-001.limits: No browser JavaScript execution, live Python integration rerun, Dioxus browser audit or whole-dashboard XSS guarantee claimed. HTML esc lacks apostrophe escaping by design; inspected interpolated attributes are double-quoted, while inline JS uses JSON quoting.

verification: Command validation uses checked groups+solos and checked groups*friends_max+solos before serialization/reqwest send.

Public with_shape and private build_roster return Result and validate before RNG, roster allocations, generation loops and broadcast channel; invalid regeneration leaves existing roster unchanged. Source order inspected and existing regressions passed.
Loopback request counter remains zero for rejected oversized/u32-extreme commands. Million groups was validation-only; never constructed or posted.

5929 independently computed policy cases passed without panic in each of debug and optimized release. Only small valid mock populations constructed: seven friends plus three solos gives ten agents; explicit singleton mock group gives one. Boundary populations are serialized/validated only, not allocated.
RWF-POP-BOUND-001.policy_note: 16 is a resource ceiling, not an RO party-size rule. Rust min1/mock and existing upstream live min2 distinction is deliberate; this review does not change upstream semantics.
RWF-POP-BOUND-001.remaining: Matching Python WorldState/SocietyRoster resource bounds at all upstream generation entrypoints are still missing and must be implemented and independently reviewed. Direct upstream callers bypass Rust. No overall population or end-to-end resource acceptance.

verification: Legal JSON u32 extrema return Invalid under catch_unwind in existing population tests, run in debug and optimized release.

Independent cross-product includes zero/boundary/million/u32::MAX counts and zero/min1/seven/16/17/u32::MAX sizes, checked against a widened u64 oracle. All 5929 cases reject/accept correctly in both profiles; no panic observed.
Standalone optimized probes use opt-level=3, overflow-checks=off, debug-assertions=off and workspace thin LTO against release world_feed rlib.
RWF-OVERFLOW-001.limits: Approval covers roster command arithmetic only, not every arithmetic expression or Python generation.

verification: Independent exact SSE sequence: IDs0,3; HTTP503; successful comment-only; successful empty; replayedID0; comment-only; empty; newerID4. Gap retained at all eight steps; restart retained from old-ID step; transient503 clears only on successful reconnect. Cursor never resets automatically and ends4.
Fresh adapter alone has no warnings/no cursor; prior adapter retains both facts. These assertions pass in debug and optimized release.
Existing held-open comment-only regression confirms events_status connected still classifies health stale after integrity loss; it also exercises gap/restart retention across successful reconnects.
Source inspection confirms no assignment clearing replay_gap/possible_restart except construction of fresh Cache::default.
RWF-GAP-001.limits: No reconciliation, durable/epoch replay or Python lifecycle acceptance. Denied expanded cache/streaming-body/malformed-SSE follow-up was not retried or rerouted.

security_concerns.finding: Rust admission/mock-generation boundaries are verified, but the authoritative original review and implementation report retain missing upstream Python generation resource bounds. End-to-end population safety remains blocked.
